name: C1 Ariete
protection: Steel/composite armour of 1990s standard; C2 upgrade underway. Game: immune to all small arms incl. 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm on frontal arc; only launchers (Javelin, top-attack) or tank guns kill it; tandem-HEAT launchers (AT4 HEDP no, RPG-7 PG-7V only to sides/rear) can disable tracks, optics and side hull.
visual_notes: Boxy angular turret with flat vertical faces and large rear bustle
7 road wheels per side, full-length side skirts
Commander's sight on the turret roof
